Enter the raw GraphQL query to send to the Data Gateway API. {{$json.field}} reads a field of the current item (same as {{$json.output.field}}); values inside "…" strings are escaped automatically.
NODE_SCHEMA_ACTION_DATA_ACTION_V1.FIELDS: Fields to fetch from the collection. Auto-populated when you select a collection. Remove fields you don't need.
NODE_SCHEMA_ACTION_DATA_ACTION_V1.FIELD_: Field values for insert or update operations. Auto-populated from collection schema.
NODE_SCHEMA_ACTION_DATA_ACTION_V1.KEY_VA: Key-value filter conditions for querying, updating, or deleting data
NODE_SCHEMA_ACTION_DATA_ACTION_V1.RAW_QU: <0>Raw Query</0> is recommended for new nodes.
NODE_SCHEMA_ACTION_DATA_ACTION_V1.SELECT: Select a client credential for authenticating with the Data Gateway API
Select how to authenticate with the Data Gateway API
Select the data collection to operate on
NODE_SCHEMA_ACTION_DATA_ACTION_V1.THE_TY: The type of data operation to perform
NODE_SCHEMA_ACTION_FUNCTION.THE_DEPLOYED: The deployed function this step runs. Only Live functions are listed, and not always all of them. One whose workflow trigger is turned off is shown greyed out until that trigger is enabled in the function's settings.
NODE_SCHEMA_ACTION_FUNCTION.THE_PAYLOAD_: The payload handed to the function as its input. Placeholders in {{ }} are resolved when the step runs; values inside quotes are escaped automatically. Must be valid JSON after that, or the step fails.
NODE_SCHEMA_ACTION_FUNCTION.WHAT_THE_FUN: What the function receives as its input. "Previous step's output" forwards the incoming item as-is; "Custom JSON" lets you compose the payload, pulling values from earlier steps.
NODE_SCHEMA_ACTION_FUNCTION.WRITE_THE_JS: Write the JSON the function should receive. Insert values from earlier steps with <0>{{$json.field}}</0> for a field of the incoming item (same as <1>{{$json.output.field}}</1>), <2>{{$node["Step name"].json.output.field}}</2> for any earlier step, or <3>{{$context.Input}}</3> for the trigger data. Without quotes a value keeps its type: text, number, true/false or object. Inside quotes (<4>"Hi {{$json.name}}"</4>) it becomes part of the text and is escaped automatically. If the input is not valid JSON after the values are filled in, the step fails. When testing this step on its own with nothing connected, the incoming item is empty.
NODE_SCHEMA_ACTION_HTTP_REQUEST_V1.ATTAC: Attaches a bearer token to the Authorization header. Blocks Authentication uses the run's delegated token, or the caller's own token if there is none; if neither exists, no token is sent. Client Credential exchanges an IAM credential.
NODE_SCHEMA_ACTION_HTTP_REQUEST_V1.CONTE: Content-Type to use to send body parameters
NODE_SCHEMA_ACTION_HTTP_REQUEST_V1.JSON_: JSON body sent with the request. Expressions are resolved for each item: {{$json.field}} reads a field of the current item (same as {{$json.output.field}}). Values inside quotes are escaped automatically. If the body is not valid JSON after that, the step fails.
NODE_SCHEMA_ACTION_HTTP_REQUEST_V1.SELEC: Select a client credential for authenticating the outbound request
NODE_SCHEMA_ACTION_HTTP_REQUEST_V1.THE_U: The URL to make the request to
NODE_SCHEMA_ACTION_HTTP_REQUEST_V1.WHETH: Whether the request has query params or not
Whether the request has headers or not
Whether the request has a body or not
NODE_SCHEMA_ACTION_PROXY.JSON_BODY_FORWA: JSON body forwarded to the upstream. Keys from the proxy config are prefilled and locked; add your own fields around them. Must be a JSON object when the proxy config merges body fields. {{$json.field}} reads a field of the current item (same as {{$json.output.field}}); values inside quotes are escaped automatically. If the body is not valid JSON after that, the step fails.
NODE_SCHEMA_ACTION_PROXY.OFF_THE_WHOLE_U: Off: the whole upstream response is returned.
NODE_SCHEMA_ACTION_PROXY.SENT_WITH_EVERY: Sent with every call to this endpoint: the connection's headers, with the endpoint's own rows replacing same-name ones.
NODE_SCHEMA_ACTION_PROXY.SENT_WITH_THE_C: Sent with the call as the query string. Locked rows come from the proxy config and can't be changed here; add your own below them. Values accept expressions; a key whose value resolves to empty is dropped.
NODE_SCHEMA_ACTION_PROXY.THE_ENDPOINT_TO: The endpoint to call. This is the proxy's declared route allowlist — the gateway refuses any path that is not on it, so only these are callable.
NODE_SCHEMA_ACTION_PROXY.THE_ONLY_FIELDS: The only fields returned in the response body. Nested fields are written with dots.
NODE_SCHEMA_ACTION_PROXY.THE_PROXY_TO_CA: The proxy to call. Only enabled proxies are listed. The upstream URL, injected headers, credentials and response shaping all stay in the proxy.
NODE_SCHEMA_ACTION_PROXY.THE_UPSTREAM_UR: The upstream URL this endpoint calls.
NODE_SCHEMA_ACTION_PROXY.THIS_ENDPOINT_N: This endpoint no longer exists on the proxy.
NODE_SCHEMA_ACTION_PROXY.VALUES_FOR_THE_: Values for the {name} segments of the selected endpoint. Each matches exactly one path segment and accepts expressions.
NODE_SCHEMA_ACTION_PROXY.WHAT_THE_PROXY_: What the proxy adds to this call, read live from the proxy. Edit the proxy to change it.
NODE_SCHEMA_ACTION_PROXY.WHETHER_THE_CAL: Whether the call carries query-string parameters. Always on when the proxy config adds query parameters to this endpoint.
NODE_SCHEMA_ACTION_PROXY.WHETHER_THE_REQ: Whether the request carries a JSON body. Always on when the proxy config merges body fields into this endpoint.
NODE_SCHEMA_ACTION_PROXY.WHO_MAY_CALL_TH: Who may call this proxy over HTTP. Blocks token: the caller must send a valid Blocks access token, and meet the role and permission rules below. Public: anyone can call it. Workflow steps are not checked against these rules.
NODE_SCHEMA_ACTION_SEND_MAIL_V1.CHOOSE_L: Choose language for the email template
NODE_SCHEMA_ACTION_SEND_MAIL_V1.CHOOSE_T: Choose the email template to use
NODE_SCHEMA_ACTION_SEND_MAIL_V1.STORAGE_: Storage File IDs to attach. Use a literal File ID, or an expression such as {{$json.fileId}} or {{$node["NodeName"].json.output.fileId}} to resolve it per run.
NODE_SCHEMA_LOGIC_IF_V1.ADD_CONDITIONS_T: Add conditions to evaluate and determine the execution path.
NODE_SCHEMA_LOGIC_IF_V1.SELECT_THE_TYPE_: Select the type of condition to evaluate.
NODE_SCHEMA_LOGIC_SWITCH_V2.RULES_ARE_CH: Rules are checked from top to bottom. Each rule is one output.
NODE_SCHEMA_LOGIC_SWITCH_V2.WHERE_ITEMS_: Where items that match no rule go.

NODE_SCHEMA_TRANSFORM_CODE_V1.SELECT_THE: Select the programming language for the script.
NODE_SCHEMA_TRANSFORM_CODE_V1.WRITE_YOUR: Write your transformation script here. Use the provided variables to access input data.
NODE_SCHEMA_TRANSFORM_MERGE_V2.APPEND_OU: Append outputs the items of Input 1, then Input 2, and so on.
NODE_SCHEMA_TRANSFORM_MERGE_V2.OUTPUT_ON: Output only when every connected input has data. Otherwise, output nothing.
NODE_SCHEMA_TRANSFORM_MERGE_V2.OUTPUT_TH: Output the data from every input that has some. Empty inputs are skipped.
NODE_SCHEMA_TRANSFORM_MERGE_V2.WHETHER_M: Whether Merge needs data on every connected input.
NODE_SCHEMA_TRANSFORM_SETFIELD_V1.ENTER_: Enter a JSON object. {{$json.field}} reads a field of the current item (same as {{$json.output.field}}); values inside quotes are escaped automatically. If it is not valid JSON after that, the step fails.

NODE_SCHEMA_TRIGGER_BLOCKS_EVENT_V2.STRU: Structure of the trigger output data

NODE_SCHEMA_TRIGGER_SCHEDULE_V1.DAYS_OF_: Days of the week to trigger on.

NODE_SCHEMA_TRIGGER_SCHEDULE_V1.MUST_BE_: Must be in range 1-23. Note: cron stepping fires at clock hours divisible by the interval when it does not divide 24 evenly.
NODE_SCHEMA_TRIGGER_SCHEDULE_V1.SELECT_H: Select how often the scheduler should run.
NODE_SCHEMA_TRIGGER_WEBHOOK_V1.CHOOSE_WH: Choose which rule(s) the caller must satisfy. RolesOnly: only the Roles list applies. PermissionsOnly: only the Permissions list applies. RolesAndPermissions: caller must satisfy both. RolesOrPermissions: caller must satisfy either.
NODE_SCHEMA_TRIGGER_WEBHOOK_V1.COPY_THIS: Copy this URL to trigger the workflow. Send the x-blocks-key header.
NODE_SCHEMA_TRIGGER_WEBHOOK_V1.LEGACY_UR: Legacy URL with the x-blocks-key value in the path. Prefer Webhook URL above.
NODE_SCHEMA_TRIGGER_WEBHOOK_V1.PERMISSIO: Permissions the caller must hold. Constrained by the selected roles. AND = all listed permissions required, OR = at least one.
NODE_SCHEMA_TRIGGER_WEBHOOK_V1.ROLES_THE: Roles the caller must hold. AND = all listed roles required, OR = at least one.
NODE_SCHEMA_TRIGGER_WEBHOOK_V1.WHAT_DATA: What data should be returned. If it should return all items as an array or only the first item as object.
NODE_SCHEMA_TRIGGER_WEBHOOK_V1.WHEN_AND_: When and how to respond to the webhook
